g.text: Main owns processes, preload owns capability, renderer owns presentation. The
daemon is reached only over loopback HTTP; the renderer never touches storage
Supervised as a child process, but a
separate program: the desktop app can
reconnect to a running daemon, and a
detached ACP host without stopping an
Renderer to daemon. Long-lived routes sit outside middleware.Timeout on purpose.
Daemon to main process — the reverse direction people rarely expect:
IPC when a durable event deserves the user's attention
All Open Agents state lives under
pinned there rather than left at the OS
